bullets.text: Predictive Maintenance Saves Money - **Predictive maintenance** leverages IoT to reduce downtime and enhance operational efficiency for manufacturers.
Servitisation Boosts Business - **Servitisation** allows manufacturers to integrate services with products, enhancing customer relationships and margins.
Streamlined Accounting Essentials - Understanding **manufacturing costs** is crucial for refining processes and improving profit margins.
AI Readiness Assessment - Evaluating your business's preparedness for **AI** integration is essential for future growth.
Sage Acquires Criterion - This acquisition aims to simplify **cloud payroll** and human capital management for mid-sized businesses.
Making Tax Digital Guide - A free e-book outlines the requirements of **Making Tax Digital** for Income Tax for UK businesses.
